payload.summary: DIP v0.3.0 was published at https://github.com/vxu-labs/dip/releases/tag/v0.3.0. Native discovery is enabled and running on this machine. Actual raw-git.exe status bootstrap passed without a shell profile. All three platform CI jobs and the 51-case suite passed; clean package and browser checks passed. Compatible native Git worktree commands now adopt unmonitored repositories asynchronously.
payload.next: Use normal Git commands; independent Git libraries or overriding execution environments require their own integration.
